notes.title: Version 0.9.3
notes.content:
-Fixed a logic error that allowed catapults to deal damage from very long distances.
-Added an information arrow indicating the location of the flag that needs to be defended at the beginning of the 3rd map.
-Fixed a bug that sometimes left one sales slot empty in the market.
-Added some informative texts and made minor UI adjustments.
-Added new sound effects for certain actions.
-While in the market, the features provided to soldiers in the squad can be viewed by hovering the mouse over the soldiers.
-Soldiers display a reload animation while reloading ammunition.
-When leveling up, players now randomly gain some features. Currently, leveling up grants the player a random attribute increase, a certain amount of HP increase, and an increase of 1 in bomb quantity.
-Adjusted item balancing and the number of enemies in levels.

Added Manual Firing Option for Team Leader:
A new manual firing feature has been introduced for team leaders, allowing players to take direct control of the team leader's weapon. This enhancement enables precise aiming and firing, giving players greater tactical flexibility during gameplay. Players can switch between manual and automatic firing modes based on their preference. If desired, the automatic firing mode can still be enabled to maintain the previous behavior where the team leader fires automatically without player intervention.
